title: Auto Farm, Instant Kill, Auto Forge, Rebirth
features:
Farm
- 1 Click Auto Farm (Premium): clears stages, grabs the best ores, banks, forges and rebirths on its own
- Auto Stage Farm: enters a stage, clears it, picks up the ores and banks them
- Stage picker: safe for your power, best ores (last stage), or a chosen stage
- Instant Kill (Premium): every enemy dies the moment it spawns, bosses included
- Auto Attack
- Hunt Super Loot critters
- Best Ores First, with a rarity filter so junk never takes a pack slot
- Collect And Bank Now

Training
- Auto Train, 1 to 40 hits per second
- Stand In Best Train Area
- Auto Rebirth the moment you hit the requirement

Forge
- Auto Forge from anywhere with your strongest ores
- Forge Type: weapon, armor or alternate
- Ores Per Forge (4 to 13)
- Sell Ores Below a rarity for coins

Gear
- Auto Equip Best
- Auto Sell Worse Gear, with an Always Keep rarity
- Auto Buy Upgrades: OrePack, Train, Luck and more

Rewards
- Auto Claim Online Gifts
- Auto Claim Dungeon Ticket
- Claim Everything Now

Player
- Walk Speed, Jump Power, Infinite Jump, Noclip
- Anti AFK so it runs all night

Session stats: stages cleared, ores banked, forges, best forge, sold, rebirths.
Also works in 85+ other games. Save and share configs, sidebar or dock layout.
